experts.r: Data Engineer, Vestas | Toastmasters Club President
experts.tp: Data Engineering · Public Speaking · Career Growth
experts.d: Builds the data platforms wind turbines run on, and helps people speak in front of a room without dreading it.
about: Jeevitha builds large-scale data platforms at Vestas, in wind energy. She turns industrial data from turbines into datasets that machine learning, predictive maintenance and analytics can actually use.

Across seven years she has moved through front-end development, AI/ML, data engineering and research. She began at Pramati Technologies, built conversational AI on RASA and a recommendation engine at Sutra Networks, led PySpark and AWS migration work at Carelon Global Solutions, and joined Vestas in 2022.
During her Master’s she spent a year as a research assistant on virtual reality sensor tracking, work that improved tracking accuracy and led to an IEEE publication.

She holds an MS in Data Science from East Carolina University and a BE in Computer Science from Don Bosco Institute of Technology, and is certified on Databricks, SnowPro, Dataiku and AWS Solutions Architect.
She is also president of the Vestas Bangalore Toastmasters club, so alongside technical sessions she is a go-to person for speaking in front of a room with confidence.
talk: What a data engineer does, and how it differs from data science
Going abroad for a Master’s: the decision, the cost and the return
Moving from front-end development into data
Speaking in front of a room when you would rather not

about: “Most professionals don’t lose the room because they lack expertise. They lose it because they can’t tell their story.”
Manjunath helps tech, sales and leadership teams turn what they know into stories people remember and act on.

For over a decade he has trained 5,000+ professionals in digital marketing. Today he combines that with storytelling and communication, because even the best strategy still has to be explained, pitched and sold.
Recent sessions: he facilitated the Project Management Workshop for Women Leaders at Wabtec, and delivered the keynote at the Vestas Bangalore Toastmasters Open House (Division C) on 5 August 2026.
